title: Partners - BaSuka Energy
metaDescription: Partner with BaSuka Energy to build Africa's sovereign energy future: 130 MW of new generation capacity plus clean-energy infrastructure. Partnerships for investors, fuel suppliers, EPC firms, EV manufacturers, and technology providers.

sections.heading: Build Africa's clean-energy infrastructure with us
sections.body: We are selecting strategic partners to help build Africa’s sovereign energy future — fuel suppliers, engineering and EPC firms, infrastructure and climate funds, EV manufacturers, technology providers, and public-sector allies who want to co-build 130 MW new generation capacity in Africa and the Sahel's first professional smart battery-swap network.

sections.heading: Power the foundation: 130 MW of *new dispatchable capacity*
sections.intro: BaSuka's generation-first strategy begins with four utility-scale power plants delivering 130 MW of reliable, dispatchable electricity. We are securing strategic fuel, technology, engineering, financing, and public-sector partnerships to deliver this foundation.

items.label: Partnership tracks — fuel, tech, EPC, finance, public sector

cards.title: Fuel Suppliers & Traders
cards.body: Strategic fuel supply and diversified sourcing to secure energy security, price stability, and dispatchable generation.

cards.title: Engineering & EPC
cards.body: High-efficiency, lower-emission generation technologies and bankable engineering, procurement, and construction delivery.

cards.title: Infrastructure & Climate Finance
cards.body: Long-term capital for generation assets and smart-network expansion, with IoT-verified ESG and carbon data from day one.

cards.title: Public Sector & Institutions
cards.body: Government, regulators, and development institutions co-delivering dependable power and inclusive economic growth.

sections.body: These tracks mirror our integrated energy ecosystem: generation first, then smart-grid distribution, storage, swappable batteries, and clean mobility — each enabled by the firm power base beneath it.

sections.heading: Where we need your expertise
sections.intro: Our partnership model is built around three strategic pillars. Each offers a distinct integration pathway into Africa’s first IoT-enabled, solar-powered energy infrastructure network.

items.title: EV MANUFACTURERS
items.subtitle: OEM battery interoperability.
items.body: We partner with 2-wheel and 3-wheel vehicle manufacturers to integrate SIRA™ battery standards directly into new frames – ensuring high-performance mobility optimised for the Sahel environment.
bullets: Co-engineering for Sahel heat & dust tolerance
Access to BaSuka’s growing rider network

items.title: CLIMATE FUND
items.subtitle: Infrastructure & ESG investment
items.body: We provide a high-impact platform for infrastructure and climate investors – offering transparent, IoT-driven data for ESG compliance and measurable carbon avoidance through our solar-powered network.
bullets: Real-time IoT impact metrics from day one

items.title: TECHNOLOGY PROVIDER
items.subtitle: Solar, BMS & IoT solutions
items.body: We seek partners in high-efficiency PV systems, advanced battery management technology, and IoT networking to keep our smart electricity network operating at 99%+ uptime across West Africa.
bullets: High-efficiency PV panels for extreme heat
Advanced EMS for multi-use battery cycles
IoT networking for remote station monitoring

sections.heading: Four reasons to join now
sections.intro: BaSuka is not a concept – it is a fully engineered infrastructure platform targeting its upcoming pilot launch in Ouagadougou.

items.title: First-mover advantage
items.body: BaSuka is building the first professional smart battery-swap network in Africa. Partners secure preferential integration terms and first-to-market positioning in a rapidly growing EV market.

items.title: Professional Yennenga operations
items.body: Every station is managed by a certified Yennenga Warrior – a woman trained at the BaSuka Academy. This drives deep community trust, elite service standards, and an 80%+ staff retention target.

items.title: Grid-independent reliability
items.body: Solar-first Swap & Glow™ stations operate resiliently off-grid – meaning our network stays live even during frequent national grid failures across Africa. 99%+ uptime target from day one.

items.title: Multi-use SIRA™ ecosystem
items.body: One SIRA™ battery powers electric motorcycles, commercial kiosks, and household appliances. This maximises utilisation per battery unit – increasing revenue potential and broadening your addressable market.

sections.heading: How SIRA™ integration works
sections.intro: For vehicle manufacturers, integration with the SIRA™ network is engineered to be as frictionless as possible – from BMS protocol alignment to customer access.

items.title: SIRA™ interoperability
items.body: Our engineering team works directly with your R&D team to align IoT-optimised battery dimensions and BMS protocols with your 2-wheel and 3-wheel frames.

items.title: Swap & Glow™ access
items.body: Your customers get immediate access to the growing network of solar-powered stations, each managed by a certified Yennenga Warrior for elite, consistent service.

items.title: Operational uptime data
items.body: We provide live data redundancy and 99%+ uptime metrics that give your customers the confidence to make the switch from fossil-fuel vehicles to electric.

sections.heading: How to become a BaSuka Partner
sections.intro: We move quickly. From initial enquiry to signed partnership agreement, our process is designed to get strategic partners integrated before the launch window.

items.title: Initial enquiry
items.body: Email partners@basukaenergy.com with your organisation name, partnership type (OEM / Fund / Technology), and a brief summary of what you bring to the network.

items.title: Pitch deck & technical brief
items.body: We share BaSuka’s full investor/partner pitch deck and the SIRA™ technical integration brief relevant to your partnership pillar.

items.title: Discovery call
items.body: A focused 45-minute call with BaSuka’s founding team to align on integration scope, commercial terms, and launch timeline fit.

items.title: Partnership agreement
items.body: We move to a formal partnership agreement with clear deliverables, milestones, and revenue-sharing or investment terms anchored to the launch.

sections.eyebrow: READY TO BUILD THE FUTURE OF AFRICAN ENERGY?

sections.body: BaSuka Energy is opening its 130 MW generation foundation and SIRA™ network to a focused group of strategic partners — fuel suppliers, engineering firms, infrastructure funds, EV manufacturers, technology providers, and public-sector allies. Reach out today to start the conversation.

sections.body: Tell us how you'd like to collaborate — as an investor, fuel supplier, engineering firm, manufacturer, technology provider, or public-sector ally. Your message opens directly in WhatsApp.
